scope: Training-only matched phone-head initialization diagnostic, not wake recognition or deployment.
hypothesis: The seeded random610-parameter head initially favors K and gives no argmax HH/EY/M on the predefined20-crop training sample. This is not large numerical softmax saturation or a proven cause. Test whether an exactly zero kernel/bias,initially uniform per-frame token distribution,avoids the stalled complete-sequence fit under the otherwise identical recipe. Equal token probabilities do not imply equal CTC hypothesis probabilities for unequal target lengths.
optimization: Fresh original binary tensors for each arm; identical deep67x60 encoder,610-parameter head,all3112 training crops,1000 updates,batch32,draw seed1223,Adam(.0002 encoder,.003 head),mean true-length-normalized CTC and shared global clip5. Only head kernel initialization differs: seeded Glorot versus all zeros; bias is zero in both. Zero-head first encoder gradient is mathematically zero,then becomes connected after the first head update; no extra warmup or steps. No augmentation,validation,head seed search,checkpoint selection or continuation of rejected weights. Retain both final checkpoints regardless of the control result.
target_policy: Original synthesis intent only, with the original alias mapping for Nyx/Nix/Nicks. These are fixed dictionary-like hypotheses, not measured phones, teacher decodes or human pronunciation truth. Retain original binary source roles. Correct true CTC lengths 6/6/7/5; zero padding is excluded by true lengths.
readout: For each held/fitted crop, raw CTC log likelihood for each of the four predefined intent strings with equal priors. No score length correction, forced probability normalization, fitted margin or wake threshold. Unequal phone target lengths are retained. Also record greedy exact strings/edit rates and normalized true-label loss. Forced-choice metrics are not open-set false-wake rates.
audit: Replay original random full-fit control tensor hashes,draw schedule and metrics exactly. Require equal original encoder tensors,parameter counts,draws and head size across arms,with different verified initial head tensors. Retain/reconstruct the fixed20 initial training states/logits and their stats for each arm. Rebuild all actual crops;reload both checkpoints;compare all final3112x67x10 logits and four-class likelihoods bitwise;reconstruct all greedy sequences/counts/metrics/gates. Independently compare all four CTC likelihoods on20 predefined crops to NumPy float64. Floating metric reductions allow1e-12 numerical roundoff only,with exact stored summary references and integer counts. No full optimizer-trajectory replay claim.
advance_action: Only if zero arm meets every unchanged fitted-bank criterion,design a separate preregistered held-engine representation diagnostic. No automatic fold,wake validation,export,threshold choice or hardware action. Failure rejects this exact initialization recipe without a seed or step-budget extension.
limits: Fixed dictionary-like synthesis-intent phones are not verified pronunciations. Training corpus and initializer already exposed;full-bank fit cannot establish unseen-speaker/engine generalization,open-set wake FAR,latency,P4 resources or long call stability. Initialization comparison is on one fixed corpus,encoder,optimizer and budget;it cannot establish a general initialization rule or the unique cause of all prior wake failures. No reserved quality data,audio device,board,firmware,PCM speed or capture/AEC/FIFO change.
